versions.changelog:
Initial release of image-to-ppt skill.

- Provides asynchronous image-to-PPT conversion service via Scnet OCR API.
- Supports automatic polling for task completion with configurable intervals and timeouts.
- Outputs temporary PPT file download links on success, or user-friendly error messages on failure.
- Requires setup of SCNET_API_KEY and supports optional polling parameters via environment variables.
- Includes detailed setup, usage, and troubleshooting guidance in documentation.
